title: listings.engagement
description: Keyed batch read of the per-viewer engagement overlay for a page of listings — what a search-fed card cannot carry, because view_count moves faster than a re-indexed document and `viewed`/`is_favorited` differ for every reader. Answers {key: {view_count, viewed, is_favorited}}. `view_count` is public. `viewed` and `is_favorited` are null when no user_id is given: unknown is not false. A key with no listing (unknown or soft-deleted) is absent from the answer.

keys.description: Listing primary keys, as strings or integers.

user_id.description: The reader the per-viewer flags are about. Omit for an anonymous page: the flags then answer null rather than false.
